title: Mahadev betting app still active, proceeds of crime exceed ₹92,000 cr: ED
description:
The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has told a court here that the illegal operations of the Mahadev online betting app and related money laundering activities were still continuing, and the  proceeds of crime were estimated to have exceeded Rs 92,000 crore.
The central agency on Friday sought seven-day custody of the alleged kingpin of the racket, Sourabh Chandrakar, from the special court for Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) cases.
His interrogation was necessary to unravel the money trail, identify the end use of the proceeds of crime and ascertain details of "betting panels" that are still operational, the ED said.
The court remanded Chandrakar in the ED's custody till November 19.
The ED said the revised proceeds of crime generated through the Mahadev Online Book application were estimated at Rs 75,000-80,000 crore, while those linked to its sister website Skyexchange.com stood at Rs 11,000-12,000 crore. The proceeds of crime linked to Lotus365.com were around Rs 2,400 .
